messages:
alexa: quick heads-up — I ran a tiny canary for a holdtime-entropy tweak to the coalesce window. short thread with config + observations.

deploy-bot: canary deploy complete · service=runtime · canary=holdtime-entropy-2026-03-18

alexa: config I used:
```
microbatch_interval_ms: 1.6
base_coalesce_delay_ms: 0.8
jitter_ms: 0.9  # +/-
token_budget_target: 32
kernel_policy: auto-select (prefetch=enabled)
```

mike: quick q — which token_budget target did you use? also which kernel profile ended up serving most requests?

alexa: token_budget_target=32. kernel autoswitch preferred int8-v2 for mid-long seqs (seq>512) during the run.

tara: quick summary from the 1h canary: p50 22ms -> 23ms, p95 84ms -> 88ms, p99 118ms -> 131ms. throughput +3%, avg microbatch size +12%, but p99 regressed ~11%. kv hit-rate dropped ~0.6% at tail.

mike: hmm — batch size up and throughput up but tail worse. did coalesce size/time change distribution?

alexa: yes, more aggregation due to longer hold windows + jitter alignment. profiling shows a kernel switch around step 4 for requests with seq>512 which adds ~9-12ms when it happens. also saw a couple of prefix kv_miss events during early tokens.

tara: logs snippet: `kernel_switch: int8-v2 @ step=4 seq=600` and `kv_miss: prefix_mismatch (priming)`. could be cache priming timing vs bigger microbatches.

ravi: suggestion: run two quick follow-ups — (A) reduce jitter amplitude to 0.4ms and lower token_budget_target to 28, (B) keep jitter but raise token_budget_target to 36. also try 'kernel-lock' for int8-v2 to avoid on-the-fly switches for seq bands.

alexa: sounds good. I'll schedule canary-A (jitter=0.4, token=28, kernel-lock int8-v2) and canary-B (jitter=0.9, token=36, kernel-autoswitch). will add perf traces for kv eviction events and kernel-switch sampling.

ci-bot: scheduled canary jobs: canary-A id=ci-7254a, canary-B id=ci-7254b · ETA ~45m

mike: also add a tiny sampling hook that records sequence-length -> chosen-kernel per request (no payload), for 1M requests. helps correlate kernel thrash with seq histogram.

alexa: added the sampling hooks and KV eviction traces to the canaries. will post results here once 1h window completes. :thumbsup:
